label: The Maiden Voyage

stages.notes: S ON THE MAIDEN STAGE. Halves split 710 / 980 — Nyx's Spectro crew out-scored the Glacio half on a board that buffed both elements +10%.
SAME CREWS, SECOND S. Halves 750 / 880 on a board buffing Fusion and Electro — neither of which these teams run. Suggested Lv.55: the account was so little back then.
S ON THE NOSE. 1,600 exactly — halves 750 / 850, zero points to spare on an Aero/Havoc board. Same two crews bulldozing the baby stretch, 3 for 3.
THE FLAGS COME OUT. Halves 770 / 850 on a coordinated-attack board — same two crews, 4 for 4, and the game itself stamped both halves Record Synced.
THE COINS RETURN. Halves 830 / 790 — first stage where the Glacio half out-scored Nyx's crew, riding a basic-attack stacking board. 5 for 5.
THE CHAOS COMPS TOP THE CHART. 1,730 — the best Forbidden score of the stretch, halves 870 / 860, from two improvised lineups nobody can explain. Forbidden Waters closed 6 for 6, all S.
RESPAWNING WATERS, REAL CREWS. 2,900 on a 2,500 S line, halves 1,410 / 1,490, double Judgement flags on an Ember/Burning Waves board — this S is what keeps the stage auto-completing every rotation.
THREE THOUSAND FLAT. Same crews, same double Judgement flags — halves 1,420 / 1,580, 500 clear of the S line. With 7 and 8 both S'd, the auto-complete tier is sealed.

THE RECURRING POOL OPENS. 3,908 against a 3,500 S line into double Aero RES — Aemeath's Fire Burst half alone posted 2,220. Riptide is where the manual re-clears start every rotation; this one's on the books.
AEMEATH POSTS 2,220. AGAIN. Same Fire Burst crew, identical half-score two stages running — with Augusta's 1,824 front half punching through double Havoc RES for 4,044 total.

A THIRD 2,220 — XUANLING'S TURN. The cursed half-score jumps teams for the season high of 4,100 into double Electro RES, with the Edgerunners crew (Lucy/Rebecca/Mornye) debuting at 1,880 under the gramophone. Chasm closed 5 for 5.

stages.notes: SSS — TWO THOUSAND PAST THE CEILING. 7,520 in the vortex, halves 3,430 / 4,090, two Lone Lights burning through unlimited tokens and a 30% universal damage board. Aemeath's Fire Burst crew shattered her own 2,220 pattern for the finale. The Maiden Voyage ends 12 for 12.

lessons: Shill Havoc Bane buffs for Yapyap: Xuanling don't overperform Phrolova + Cantarella's Echo Skill DMG engine. SuiSui (her supposed BiS support) might change that — retest when she drops.
Phrolova + Cantarella + Shorekeeper outperformed Phrolova + Cantarella + Roccia, interestingly.
Aemeath is FUCKING CRACKED. As expected.
